source_metadata.notes: SYNTHETIC reproducibility snapshot: values are frozen output of the current model (refreshed via scripts/generators/refresh_internal_reproducibility_snapshots.py after the 2026-08-27 Wave S2c retirement of the fabricated Hofmann1998 sulfur anchor and the barrier revert that followed it). Folded in, newest first: (Wave S2c) ONE CONSTANT REVERTED, NOTHING REFITTED, NO CURVE RESHAPED. `thiol_addition_pentodiulose` 26.35 -> 28.60 kcal/mol, back to the un-fitted Wave N `thiol_addition` CLASS value, and results/validation/sulfur_barrier_refit_pentodiulose.{json,md} RETRACTED. CAUSE, and it is a provenance finding rather than a chemistry one: that refit's SOLE fit target was cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998, whose MFT 342 ppb / FFT 200 ppb Wave S2b traced to data/benchmarks/maillard_validation_benchmarks.md section 1.3 -- an abstract-reconstructed range table committed in c7efbbc, the SAME commit that created the benchmark JSON. Its row gives MFT `~0.02-0.05` mol % and FFT `~0.01-0.03` mol %; on the benchmark's declared (and unattested) 10 mM basis with MW 114.17, 0.0300 mol % -> 342.5 -> 342 ppb and the band's geometric mean 0.017321 mol % -> 197.8 -> 200 ppb. Both shipped targets are interior points of two invented, OVERLAPPING bands (~90% confidence, arithmetic exact), so the Wave P paragraph further down -- which cites 26.35 as an anchored refit -- is SUPERSEDED, and so is its 'the anchor's mol%->ppb conversion is UNVERIFIED (Wave K)' framing: the problem was never the conversion, it is that there is no measurement on the far end of it. The benchmark's 1.45x / 0.09 dex contract is retired and its tier demoted PRIMARY -> REFERENCE in the same wave. THE SULFUR BRANCH NOW HAS ZERO ABSOLUTE LITERATURE ANCHORS. ON THIS SNAPSHOT the effect is a pure re-allocation and the arithmetic is visible in the factors: 2-methyl-3-furanthiol x0.416079 and bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide x0.420049 (the disulfide is MFT-derived, so it follows), while EVERY other propagated row rises by exactly x1.010812 -- 2-furfurylthiol, furfural and 2,5-dimethylpyrazine alike -- because the fixed volatile budget re-normalises and the competitors absorb what the MFT lane gives up. A single shared factor across three chemically unrelated rows is the signature of the budget constraint, not of three coincidences. Hexanal and Nonanal are UNCHANGED (x1.000000): they are injected by the lipid lane and never propagated. THE RANKING CONTRACT DID NOT CHANGE this time -- furfural > FFT > MFT > disulfide > DMP holds before and after, and MFT stays above the disulfide because both fell together. (Wave S1b) THREE ROUTING DEFECTS REPAIRED. NO CORRECTION CURVE WAS RESHAPED, NO CONSTANT REFITTED, NOTHING TUNED TO A PANEL. Wave S2's directional-accuracy panel measured the model at 2/10 on pH and water-activity claims -- worse than a coin -- against 16/19 everywhere else, and the cause was that the pH/aw physics was written but not connected. (1) `ReactionConditions.get_ph_multiplier`, which encodes the 1,2- vs 2,3-enolisation route selection and is unit-tested for the correct signs, was NEVER CALLED on the prediction path; it is now called from `get_rate_constant`, gated to the three enolisation branch-point families so it cannot double-apply with the amine-ionisation term. (2) `_ionization_correction`'s pyrazine branch keyed on the substring 'pyrazine', which matches NO family this engine emits, so it was dead at every pH; it now keys on `Aminoketone_Condensation`, the family that actually makes 2,5-dimethylpyrazine. (3) `_water_activity_correction` reached 3 of 29 emitted families and its dehydration branch keyed on the equally dead substring 'furfural'; family membership is now decided by MEASURED net water stoichiometry, so dehydrations and condensations are water-inhibited and hydrolyses are water-driven. ON THIS SNAPSHOT (pH 5.6, aw 0.95) the sulfur and pyrazine rows all FALL, because at aw 0.95 every water-shedding step is penalised and the pyrazine step is penalised twice over (its amine is 89% protonated at pH 5.6 AND it sheds two waters): 2,5-dimethylpyrazine x0.0022206, 2-methyl-3-furanthiol x0.337600, bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide x0.496260, 2-furfurylthiol x0.504180, while furfural RISES x1.074000 (its 1,2-enolisation route gets the acid boost at pH 5.6). Hexanal and Nonanal are UNCHANGED -- they are injected by the lipid lane, not propagated through the network. THE RANKING CONTRACT CHANGED and that is a real movement, not a refresh artifact: 2-furfurylthiol now outranks 2-methyl-3-furanthiol, and bis(2-methyl-3-furyl) disulfide now outranks 2,5-dimethylpyrazine. (Wave S1) TWO STRUCTURAL FIXES TO THE PREDICTION PATH, NO CONSTANT TOUCHED. (1) THE FLUX PROPAGATOR IS NOW ADDITIVE OVER PARALLEL CHANNELS. It used to relax to the lowest-span route per product and keep THAT route's flux alone, so enriching the network with a second real route contributed exactly nothing -- Wave P measured zero on the flagship MFT number and this snapshot's own Wave P paragraph below records that finding, WHICH IS NOW SUPERSEDED. Each product's flux proxy is the SUM over kinetically distinct routes, deduplicated on the route's full ordered step-set so no route is counted twice. The alternative guard -- 'routes sharing a rate-limiting step are one channel, take the max' -- was implemented and MEASURED and REJECTED: both MFT routes here share the trunk Amadori_Rearrangement (29.06 kcal/mol) as their slowest step, so it left the flagship number unmoved, and it under-counts the conductance partition a shared bottleneck actually produces. THE BUDGET SURVIVED: the allocation layer still normalises to total_volatile_budget_molar, verified to 1e-12 before and after, so adding channels moves the SPLIT and never the total. On this snapshot the sulfur rows RISE (MFT x1.319008, FFT x1.499642) and the pyrazine / disulfide / furfural rows fall by exactly x0.974722 to pay for them. (2) THE COMPOUND-SPECIFIC MATRIX CALIBRATION REGISTRY IS REACHABLE AGAIN. Wave O's finding below -- that on the matrix_precursor_augmented path species arrive labelled by canonical SMILES ('CCCCCC=O'), so describe_matrix_calibration missed and the observability factor silently applied as 1.0 -- IS NOW FIXED, and that paragraph's 'THIS SNAPSHOT DID NOT MOVE AT ALL' is likewise SUPERSEDED. The lookup resolves a SMILES label to its compound-database name at the boundary, so these snapshots are sensitive to src/matrix_calibration_registry.py for the first time and CAN now detect drift in it (pinned in tests/scientific/test_wave_s1_additive_flux_2026_08.py). Hexanal rises by the Wave O refitted ambient factors -- pea x4.317250, soy x9.540070 -- and soy Nonanal by x1.066667 (= 0.160/0.150, the soy-vs-pea ambient release ratio); pea Nonanal is unchanged because its factor is 1.0. STILL OPEN: the runtime recomputes this snapshot's process_state as `intermediate_matrix` from 100 C / 45 min / aw 0.95, not the `aqueous_pre_extrusion_model` the benchmark file declares, so the record actually reached is the AMBIENT one via the process-state fallback. (Wave P) SIX CHANGES, EACH LITERATURE-ANCHORED, NONE TUNED TO REPRODUCE AN OUTPUT. (1) `thiol_addition_pentodiulose` REFITTED against cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998 alone, 28.60 -> 26.35 kcal/mol (one free parameter, range [23.30, 29.65]); MFT 151.87 -> 242.38 ppb vs 342 (2.25x under -> 1.41x under) and FFT 243.72 -> 218.00 vs 200 (1.22x over -> 1.09x over, co-moving, NOT fitted). The profile minimum sits at the range FLOOR, so 26.35 is the conservative edge and the residual is not removable by this barrier. The anchor's own mol%->ppb conversion is UNVERIFIED (Wave K), so that risk is now localised in one constant. Record: results/validation/sulfur_barrier_refit_pentodiulose.{json,md}. (2) THE C2+C3 RECOMBINATION LANE TO MFT was added -- Hofmann & Schieberle 1998 (10.1021/jf9705983) measured it as their HIGHEST-yielding MFT system (1.4 mol %, 6 min, 180 C, dry) and the network could not express it at all: pyruvaldehyde + H2S + 2[H] -> 1-mercapto-2-propanone; + glycolaldehyde -> 4,5-dihydroxy-3-mercapto-2-pentanone -> MFT + 2 H2O (mechanism per Cerny 2015, 10.1016/b978-1-78242-103-0.00009-6). MEASURED CONTRIBUTION TO THE SHIPPED NUMBER: EXACTLY ZERO. Alone the lane gives MFT 71.02 ppb; the pentodiulose lane gives 242.38; together 242.38, not 313. src/recommend.py selects the LOWEST-SPAN path per product, so parallel channels do not add. That is a structural finding about the flux propagator, reported and not fixed. (3) NORFURANEOL, left with zero consumers by Wave N, got the route Cerny & Davidek 2003 actually demonstrated for it: norfuraneol + 2 x 2[H] -> 2,3-pentanedione + H2O (the dicarbonyl Whitfield & Mottram 1999, 10.1021/jf980980v, measure as a main product of that exact system), then + H2S + 2[H] -> 2-mercapto-3-pentanone. (4) NONANAL IS NOW CLEAVED FROM THE OLEATE POOL, not the linoleate pool -- nonanal is in neither linoleate hydroperoxide isomer's product list (Miyazaki 2023, 10.1093/bbb/zbac189) and `LipidProfile.oleic_acid_pct` had been dead code. Nonanal falls by exactly the oleic/linoleic ratio (pea 0.4400x, soy 0.4340x) EVERYWHERE, including in this snapshot. (5) FRUCTOSE reaches HMF by its own ring-retained dehydration, not through the glucose 3-deoxyosone (Perez Locas & Yaylayan 2008, 10.1021/jf8010245, exclude it; Antal 1990, 10.1016/0008-6215(90)84096-d, for the route). No live benchmark contains fructose, so this moves zero scored rows. (6) THE DMHF [HH] POOL GATE IS GONE. The hexose 1-deoxyosone -> furaneol step was gated on a reducing-equivalent token whose only producer in a cysteine-free system was pyrazine aromatisation -- the second half of red-team H4. The accepted mechanism names the reductant and it is the amino acid (Blank & Fay 1996, 10.1021/jf950439o; Kerler et al. 2010, 10.1002/9781444317770.ch3), so the step is now `1-deoxyosone + amino acid -> DMHF + Strecker aldehyde + CO2 + NH3 + H2O`, exact with NO token. Measured on glucose+glycine: disabling aminoketone condensation now leaves DMHF steps at 1 (was 0). NET EFFECT ON THIS SNAPSHOT: the added species dilute the bounded volatile budget, so the sulfur/pyrazine/furfural rows move together by ~0.87x, and Nonanal moves by the oleate ratio. Both are re-pinned here. (Wave O) THE AMBIENT-SLURRY HEXANAL OBSERVABILITY FACTORS WERE REFITTED against the CONTENT-VERIFIED Pratap-Singh anchors (Molecules 2021, 26, 4104 Table 1: pea hexanal 1138.00 ppb, soy hexanal 1621.71 ppb), replacing constants back-solved from the 260 / 380 ppb transcription errors Wave K found. ONE shared scale of 4.317249x was fitted across both lanes; the pea-vs-soy release ratio (2.2098) is unchanged, and the 2-pentylfuran factors were NOT touched because 638 / 2492 were verified verbatim. Record: results/validation/matrix_observability_refit_pratap_singh.{json,md}. The soy heated_matrix hexanal factor is DEFINED as the soy ambient baseline times the Shu 2024 attenuation, so it was propagated (0.649668 -> 2.80478) rather than left composed with a stale baseline. THIS SNAPSHOT DID NOT MOVE AT ALL, and the reason is itself a finding: on the matrix_precursor_augmented path the network species arrive labelled by SMILES ('CCCCCC=O'), not by name, so describe_matrix_calibration finds no record, returns calibration_observable_factor=None and applies 1.0. The compound-specific matrix observability registry is therefore UNREACHABLE from this path -- these snapshots are insensitive to every constant in it. Recorded, not fixed. HONEST EFFECT ON THE EXTERNAL HOLD-OUT: it got WORSE -- median |log10| 1.1849 -> 1.6296 dex (15.31x -> 42.62x), coverage 5/8 -> 4/8. Bi 2020 raw pea improved 5.37x -> 1.24x, but Liu 2023 went 4.52x -> 19.50x and Li 2026 hexanal 21.58x -> 93.15x, because the pea ambient lane carries two contradictory external measurements (1260 vs 51.96 ppb) whose geometric mean the erroneous 260 ppb happened to sit on. (Wave N) THE MFT ROUTE WAS CORRECTED ON ISOTOPE EVIDENCE. The norfuraneol + H2S -> MFT step (`Thiol_Addition_Norfuraneol`) was RETIRED: Cerny & Davidek 2003 (10.1021/jf026123f) spiked authentic norfuraneol into a [13C5]ribose/cysteine system and the MFT came out mainly 13C5-labelled, i.e. norfuraneol is 'unimportant as an intermediate'; Cerny & Davidek 2004 (10.1021/jf035265m) positionally confirmed 1,4-dideoxypento-2,3-diulose with [1-13C]ribose. Two families replace it: `Deoxyosone_Reduction` (1-deoxy-2,3-pentodiulose + 2[H] -> 1,4-dideoxypento-2,3-diulose + H2O, barrier 28.0 ESTIMATED) and `Thiol_Addition_Pentodiulose` (1,4-dideoxyosone + H2S -> MFT + 2 H2O, barrier 28.60 ESTIMATED and UNCONSTRAINED, deliberately NOT the 26.85 that Wave H fitted through the contradicted route, and NOT tuned). The H2S step no longer consumes a reducing-equivalent token; the reduction moved upstream. Norfuraneol is retained as a genuine furanone product, demoted out of the MFT lane. Honest effect on cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998: MFT 235.32 -> 151.87 ppb against 342 (1.45x under -> 2.25x under) and FFT 219.96 -> 243.72 against 200 (1.10x over -> 1.22x over). The numbers got WORSE and were NOT clawed back: the 1.45x had been bought with a barrier fitted through a route the isotope evidence contradicts. (Wave I) the norfuraneol + H2S -> MFT step no longer draws its 2[H] reducing equivalent from a pool whose only source was pyrazine chemistry -- the reductant is now sourced from the thiol redox couple (2 cysteine -> cystine + 2[H]), so MFT no longer goes to zero when aminoketone condensation is disabled. Measured effect on cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998: MFT 61.25 -> 235.32 ppb against a 342 ppb reference (5.58x under -> 1.45x under) and FFT 61.44 -> 219.96 against 200 (3.26x under -> 1.10x over), with NO barrier changed. The Lipid_Schiff_Base SMARTS finally implements the exclusions its comment claimed (no alpha-hydroxy carbonyls, C3+ only), taking the family from 75.2% of the core no-lipid network to 27.2%. The demoted one-step MFT shortcut no longer fires for pentoses. The Methional hydrolysate observability factor was REVERTED 0.05623 -> 0.0045: the two benchmarks it had been re-derived against are fabricated and are now quarantined. 10 of 14 Monte-Carlo barrier priors were exact no-ops and now route correctly, widening every confidence interval. (G1) the fabricated lipid radical chain was deleted -- 93% of the emitted network, 5500 -> 369 steps -- and hexanal, norfuraneol, glyoxal, CML, DMHF and the correct disulfide regioisomer became reachable; the accepted 1-deoxyosone -> norfuraneol -> MFT route (van den Ouweland & Peer 1975) replaced the fabricated one-step shortcut, which is demoted but retained as a lump; eight families that had been silently switched off by the 45 kcal/mol DEFAULT_BARRIER fallthrough (acrylamide, CML/CEL, furanone, thiamine, GSH) were given explicit estimated barriers and are now live. (Wave H) `Enolisation_2_3_Amadori` stopped collecting the amine-nucleophile ionisation and Amadori water-activity corrections it was matching by name alone, which is what had left the new MFT route inert; `thiol_addition_norfuraneol` was refit 28.60 -> 26.85 against cys_ribose_140C_Hofmann1998 only (that refit is now STALE -- it was performed against a network in which the MFT route was throttled by the H2 coupling Wave I removed, so its 'no barrier value can fix this' conclusion does not carry over and re-running it is an open owner item). (2026-08-27 earlier) the projection retune: an apparent-Arrhenius conversion extent replaced the saturating severity sigmoid and the double-applied Boltzmann selectivity on path_span was de-duplicated. (2026-08-26) the audit bug fixes -- marker-injection mM basis, 2-pentylfuran SMILES, full MolWt. This is a drift-detection baseline, not a measurement, and carries zero calibration evidence.
